children.title: ClassGame · From lesson to learning evidence

steps.title: Prepare a mission draft
steps.description: A teacher uploads optional material directly to temporary intake, then calls the Go API. The mission workflow summarizes supported material, validates generated questions and saves a draft revision. Preview progress streams through SSE.

steps.title: Review, publish and protect files
steps.description: The teacher reviews a draft revision. When jobs are enabled, file-copy work is enqueued before the publication transaction. Workers verify the published revision and copy validated sources to private storage; failed jobs retry.

steps.title: Play a question with Mia
steps.description: A student answer is saved locally before a grounded tutoring request. Mia responds synchronously through the shared policy and provider port. Shared Redis admission bounds model work; the tutor is not a background queue consumer.

steps.title: Commit completion, then finalize
steps.description: The API commits accepted answers and completion before insights finish. An optional worker claims scoped evidence, uses the same learning workflow, and commits version-checked private traces. Jobs disabled or unavailable use the same finalizer inline.

edges.label: Inline finalization if queue is unavailable

steps.title: Refresh class insights safely
steps.description: A class refresh consumes bounded, finalized evidence and persists a versioned summary. The teacher dashboard reads authorized paged insights through the API; scoped realtime invalidates views rather than streaming full history or private worksheets to the model.

edges.label: Inline refresh when jobs are disabled
